unchanged_model: labelled q12 heat bath, per-slot rate 1, leave-one-out, denominator N, g=12/Lambda6
block: deterministic first k slots (or any predetermined subset)
native_counts: b_j=#block state j; o_j=#outside state j; n=b+o
refresh_rates: block b_i softmax_j((g/N) A(n-e_i)); outside o_i softmax_j((g/N)A(n-e_i))
reflect: suppress precisely transitions for which new total n is outside inherited D_N
reflected_stationary_weight: k!/prod(b_i!) (N-k)!/prod(o_i!) exp[g/(2N)n^T A n] 1_{n in D_N}
initial: reflective pi_D via previous MT; actual iid uniform via conditional labelled coupling
errors: stationary smooth generator bound C (N^-1/4 + k^-1/2 + N*pi_D(boundary)/sqrt(k)) with inherited MT moments
scope: 1<=k<=N/2, only stationary L1 smooth tests, not full-path limit
